name: broken-runtime
purpose: The system is wrong, not the data: the worker is missing, jobs are in the dead-letter queue, the queue has a backlog, an attempt has been running for six hours, and the last completed attempt was blocked on a publication check.
edge_cases: Runtime checks fail while every source succeeded: Home must separate them from attempts (S3).
The last completed attempt was blocked on a publication check, not on a source (S3).
An attempt has been running for six hours and must read as running, not as failed.
37 dead-letter jobs and a 2,566-job backlog, on Home only.
A view whose last run failed with a two-line timeout error.
